{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue — remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print("Number of QA orders:", qa_mask.sum())

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
print("Number of refunded orders:", refunded_mask.sum())

# Final valid population: exclude QA and refunded orders
valid_mask = ~(qa_mask | refunded_mask)
print("Total valid orders:", valid_mask.sum())

df_valid = df[valid_mask].copy()

# Compute conversion rate for email channel
email_conv = df_valid[df_valid['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()

# Compute conversion rate for paid_search channel
paid_search_conv = df_valid[df_valid['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

# Compute raw difference (email - paid_search)
raw_diff = email_conv - paid_search_conv

# Print results
print(f"Conversion rate for email: {email_conv:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate for paid_search: {paid_search_conv:.4f}")
print(f"Raw difference (email - paid_search): {raw_diff:.4f}")"}
